# SDM Model Evaluation Tool User Guide for Synthesis

> How to synthesize evaluations

## Installation

Install the following R packages:

- rmarkdown
- sf
- terra
- sdmEvalToolCore
- sdmEvalToolUI

## Finding material/deployment related files

The files are organized according to the [SDM Tool Specifications](../spec/)

## Working with the database

Connect to the database:
```r
con <- db_connect()
```

Read the deployments table and filter to a select `deployment_id`:
```r
t_dp <- db_read_table(con, "deployments") |>
    dplyr::filter(deployment_id == .env$deployment_id)
```

Read the models table and filter to a select `model_id`:
```r
t_mo <- db_read_table(con, "models") |>
    dplyr::filter(model_id == .env$model_id)
```

Read the species table and filter to a select `species_id`:
```r
t_sp <- db_read_table(con, "species") |>
    dplyr::filter(species_id == .env$species_id)
```

Read the user information for a deployment:
```r
t_u <- db_read_user_info(con, user_id = user_id, deployment_id = deployment_id)
```

Read evaluations for a user and deployment:
```r
d <- db_read_evaluations(
    con,
    deployment_id = deployment_id,
    user_id = user_id
)
```

A nicely formatted version of the evaluations:
```r
q <- prep_evaluations(user_id = user_id)
e <- prep_evaluations(user_id = user_id) |>
    tidyr::unnest("answers")
```

Disconnect from the database:
```r
db_disconnect(con)
```

## Single evaluations

See the [parametrized Rmd template](../working/report-single-evaluation.Rmd).

The template takes the following parameters:

- `user_id`: user ID for the single evaluation
- `model_id`: model ID
- `species_id`: species ID
- `deployment_id`: deployment ID
- `base_path`: base path relative to the Rmd file

You can provide these when rendering the file:

```r
rmarkdown::render(
    input = "working/report-single-evaluation.Rmd", 
    params = list(
    user_id = "testuser",
    model_id = "bam_v5_can71",
    species_id = "BBWA",
    deployment_id = "deployment1",
    base_path = "../misc/test"
))
```

Follow along the Rmd file to see how to display various types of model
materials and the corresponding evaluations.

The Rmd file also shows how to calculate the time it takes for the evaluation to
be completed based on the saved timestamps.
